hero.title: Distance shouldn't stop movie night.
hero.subtitle: Watch your favorite movies together, talk, chat and react — wherever you are.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to stream movies in perfect harmony
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create a private cinema room and share the invite code or link with your partner.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Each person selects their own local video file. No files are uploaded to our servers.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Playback, voice, reactions, and chat stay seamlessly synchronized in real-time.
howItWorks.privacyNote: Your video stays on your device. We don't upload or store your video files.

features.title: Built for intimate cinema moments
features.syncDesc: Precision clock correction gently aligns playback speeds without sudden skipping.
features.voiceDesc: Talk naturally over WebRTC voice mesh with speaking visualizers and instant mute.
features.privacyDesc: Direct browser File APIs play movies locally. Zero server bandwidth or copyright issues.
features.reactionsDesc: Express your emotions in real-time with floating reaction bursts across the screen.
